title: HASiL notice: functional improvements to the MyInvois Portal / Application
summary: CTIM has circulated a HASiL information notice on e-Invoice titled 'Functional Improvements to MyInvois Portal/Application'. The document could not be opened from the tracker (CTIM's download returned an empty file, likely because it needs member sign-in), and the notice was not yet on HASiL's e-Invoice pages or the MyInvois SDK release notes, so its contents have not been confirmed.
